description: The chart is a two-layered donut chart representing the results of a survey on the effectiveness of different types of social engineering attacks. The outer layer, labeled "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)," shows three categories: "Deceived" with 67.6%, "Partially" with 57.9%, and "Not Deceived" with 10.5%. The inner layer, labeled "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)," also shows three categories: "Deceived" with 31.6%, "Partially" with 23.5%, and "Not Deceived" with 8.8%. The chart includes a legend with color coding for each category, and the percentages are displayed within the corresponding slices. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as exploded or offset slices, nor does it indicate any order of magnitude for the proportions.
